hero.title: Tell Klacksy (our AI helper) what to do. Klacksy takes care of it — after your yes.
hero.noLicense: No license fees under the AGPL.
hero.engineNote: The rule-based planning engine calculates the plan. Klacksy understands your sentence, controls Klacks and explains what is happening.
hero.examplesLabel: This is how you talk to Klacksy — you can see these sentences in the videos:
hero.example.0: Group all employees by qualification — one group per qualification.
hero.example.1: Start the planning assistant for Winterthur from 2 to 8 November 2026.
hero.example.2: Group all employees by their address: region, city and, below them, municipalities — only larger concentrations as a group of their own.
audience.title: For small, medium-sized and large businesses
audience.small.label: Small
audience.small.text: You say what you need — Klacks plans, you confirm. Without license fees, on an office PC.
audience.mid.label: Medium
audience.mid.text: Fewer people, the same number of shifts: Klacks fills gaps in line with your rules and suggests a replacement who fits.
audience.large.label: Large
audience.large.text: No license per employee, no user fees, no subscription — with 2,000 people the maths works out differently than with 20.
audience.industriesDetails: What Klacks covers in each industry
scene.title: Monday, 6:40 a.m. Someone is missing from the early shift.
scene.text: You quickly assign a colleague who worked a late shift until 10 p.m. yesterday. Klacks flags it immediately: rest period too short — 9 hours instead of the configured 11. You see the problem before the schedule goes out, not only when someone works it out afterwards.

trust.openSource.title: Open source under AGPL-3.0
trust.openSource.text: The source code of the backend and the interface is public. Your IT team can check what Klacks does with personnel data — and keep running Klacks independently of us.
trust.data.title: Data sovereignty
trust.data.text: Klacks runs on your own servers. Personnel data is held in your infrastructure — which makes data protection under the laws of your country easier.
trust.ai.title: Your choice of AI model
trust.ai.text: Klacksy works with the model of your choice — from external providers to a model you run yourself. You decide on cost, data protection and provider.
trust.lockIn.title: No lock-in with big cloud providers
trust.lockIn.text: Your data lives in your own database (PostgreSQL), the code is open, and you switch the AI provider in the settings.
trust.costNote: No license fees does not mean no costs. Servers, operation and maintenance cost money, and so does an external AI model — what you do not pay is a fee per employee.
trust.stat.0: Your IT team can check every line.
trust.stat.1: Schedulers work in their own language.
trust.stat.2: Templates for care, hospitals, security, building services, logistics and hospitality.
trust.stat.3: Public holidays and rules preconfigured for your country.
agents.title: Your AI agents work directly with Klacks
agents.text: Klacks speaks MCP (Model Context Protocol), the open standard through which AI agents work with software. Any agent that speaks the open standard MCP — such as Claude, Cursor or your own agents — can work directly with Klacks: with the tools Klacksy uses as well, and only with the rights of the connected user.
agents.limits: Operating steps in the interface and sensitive functions such as managing access tokens stay locked, and an agent never receives more than supervisor rights.
